reponse:
Martin raised two issues on the November 12 sync [2].

1. **Webhook signature failures.** Ellen Vance reported that almost every `payout.paid` and `seller.verified` event failed signature verification on sandbox, and her team had turned verification off there [2]. Jake Whitfield took it and suspected a serialization problem on our side [2], and Ellen posted the failing event IDs in #ext-tradewell [4]. I found no fix or closing note in the sources, so it looks open.

2. **Per-seller payout schedules.** About 200 top sellers are on net-7 today and the rest on net-30, and Martin said Tradewell needs per-seller schedules or it will downgrade its best sellers on day one [2]. Owen Park promised an answer by Friday November 20 [4]. Engineering picked it up as QPAY-2362: Tomer Golan estimated 3–4 weeks [3]. On November 16, Avi Kessler moved it to Backlog with a 2027-Q1 target, earliest late January, and asked Owen to set expectations with Martin [3]. So this is not going to happen before December 7, which conflicts with Martin's statement that the date can't move [2]. I found no record that Owen has sent Martin that answer yet.

I also need to correct my previous reply. I cited 1,950 KYC-verified sellers as of November 16 and a November 30 import date, but I can't find either figure in the sources I read now. The only count I see is about 1,400 of 3,200 sellers verified on November 12 [2], so please treat the 1,950 figure as unconfirmed.
